###B2
```{r}

  print("Child")
} else if (age <= 19) {
  print("Teenager")
} else {
  print("Adult")
}
```

### PART C
```{r}
if (file.exists("students_grades.csv")) {
  grades <- read.csv("students_grades.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  print("File imported successfully.")
} else {
  print("Error: students_grades.csv not found in the working directory.")
}
```


```{r}
head(grades)           
dim(grades)           
str(grades)            
summary(grades)        
colSums(is.na(grades))  
```

```{r}
if (nrow(grades) == 15 && ncol(grades) == 7 && sum(is.na(grades)) == 1) {
  print("Check passed: 15 rows, 7 columns, and 1 NA confirmed.")
} else {
  print("Check failed: Unexpected dimensions or NA count.")
}
```


```{r}
grades$FinalGrade <- (0.30 * grades$Quiz) + (0.30 * grades$Midterm) + (0.40 * grades$Final)
grades
```

```{r}
grades$Result <- ifelse(is.na(grades$FinalGrade), "Incomplete",
                        ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 75, "Passed", "Failed"))
grades
```


```{r}
grades$Remarks <- ifelse(is.na(grades$FinalGrade), "Incomplete",
                  ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 90, "Excellent",
                  ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 85, "Very Good",
                  ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 80, "Good",
                  ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 75, "Fair", "Needs Improvement")))))
grades
```


```{r}
grades$AttendanceFlag <- ifelse(grades$Attendance < 80, "At Risk", "OK")
grades
```


```{r}
grades$Honors <- ifelse(!is.na(grades$FinalGrade) & grades$FinalGrade >= 90 & grades$Attendance >= 90, 
                        "Yes", "No")
grades
```

```{r}
grades$Result_Loop <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(grades)) {
  if (is.na(grades$FinalGrade[i])) {
    grades$Result_Loop[i] <- "Incomplete"
  } else if (grades$FinalGrade[i] >= 75) {
    grades$Result_Loop[i] <- "Passed"
  } else {
    grades$Result_Loop[i] <- "Failed"
  }
}
grades
```


```{r}
table(grades$Result)
table(grades$AttendanceFlag)
table(grades$Honors)

```

```{r}
ncol(grades) == 12
names(grades)
```

### PART D
```{r}
write.csv(grades, "students_grades_processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
at_risk <- grades[grades$AttendanceFlag == "At Risk", ]

if (nrow(at_risk) > 0) {
  write.csv(at_risk, "at_risk_students.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  print("Exported at_risk_students.csv")
} else {
  print("No at-risk students to export.")
}
```

```{r}
honors <- grades[grades$Honors == "Yes", c("StudentID", "Name", "Section", "FinalGrade", "Attendance")]

if (nrow(honors) > 0) {
  write.csv(honors, "honors_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  print("Exported honors_list.csv")
} else {
  print("No honors candidates to export.")
}
```

```{r}
check_processed <- read.csv("students_grades_processed.csv")
check_at_risk   <- read.csv("at_risk_students.csv")
check_honors    <- read.csv("honors_list.csv")

nrow(check_processed) == 15
nrow(check_at_risk) == 4
nrow(check_honors) == 4
```

```{r}
write.csv(at_risk, "temp_with_rownames.csv")
head(read.csv("temp_with_rownames.csv"))
```

```{r}
grades$Scholarship <- ifelse(is.na(grades$FinalGrade), "Pending",
                      ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 95 & grades$Attendance >= 90, "Full",
                      ifelse(grades$FinalGrade >= 85 & grades$Attendance >= 90, "Partial", "None")))
grades
```

```{r}
scholarship_candidates <- grades[grades$Scholarship %in% c("Full", "Partial"), ]

if (nrow(scholarship_candidates) > 0) {
  write.csv(scholarship_candidates, "scholarship_candidates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  print("Exported scholarship_candidates.csv")
} else {
  print("No scholarship candidates found.")
}
grades
```

```{r}
table(grades$Scholarship)
```
